# Obed Abernethy

## Overview

- **Gender:** Male
- **Status:** Deceased
- **Origin:** Innsmouth, Massachusetts
- **Role:** Sea captain
- **Titles:** Captain

## Appearance

Captain Obed Abernethy is an elderly man whose appearance exhibits advanced stages of the 'Innsmouth look.' He possesses unblinking, watery blue eyes, a broad flat nose, and rough, scaly skin along his neck and face. His ears are underdeveloped, and his gait is a shuffling, clumsy waddle.

## Personality

Obed is ruthless, secretive, and deeply pragmatic, willing to abandon conventional morality and human religious faith for tangible wealth and prosperity. Driven by desperation to save his failing town, he embraced dark pacts with alien entities without remorse. He is fiercely devoted to the esoteric cult he established, maintaining strict control through intimidation and fear.

## Traits

- Pragmatic
- Ruthless
- Secretive
- Religious fanatic

## Abilities

- Seamanship and navigation
- Leadership and cult organization
- Communion with Deep Ones

## Goals

- Restore the economic prosperity of Innsmouth through trade with the Deep Ones
- Establish and enforce the worship of Dagon and the Esoteric Order of Dagon
- Ensure the survival and proliferation of human-Deep One hybrids

## History

Obed Abernethy was a merchant captain from Innsmouth who traded extensively in the South Seas. When Innsmouth suffered severe economic decline and poor fishing yields following the War of 1812, Abernethy sought a solution based on dark rites he had observed among Kanak natives in the Pacific. He established contact with the Deep Ones, an immortal underwater race, trading sacrifices and human intermarriage in exchange for plentiful fish and unusual gold jewelry. He founded the Esoteric Order of Dagon, gradually forcing the townsfolk to adopt the cult and take blood oaths. When local opposition mounted in 1846, Abernethy and his followers quashed dissent through violent purges. Although he was eventually arrested during a brief governmental investigation, the town remained under the complete influence of his cult, and his lineage continued to lead Innsmouth into full hybridization with the aquatic beings.

## Background by volume

- Traded in the South Pacific where he first encountered islanders who sacrificed to aquatic entities
- Brought odd golden jewelry and strange rites back to Innsmouth after the War of 1812 ruined local fishing
- Founded the Esoteric Order of Dagon to replace traditional Christian churches in Innsmouth

## Affiliations

- Esoteric Order of Dagon — Founder and Leader
- The Deep Ones — Human Emissary and Cult Leader
